summary: Iter33 retest of the 3 fixes from iter32 — ALL 3 PASS. (1) GET /api/tables/{table_id}/messages now invokes _attach_founder_flags(docs, 'user_id') at server.py:3898 and the existing TestTableMessagesFounderEnrichment (which failed in iter32) now passes: a founder-authored message carries user_is_founder=true + user_founder_number=<int>, and a non-founder authored message has user_is_founder=None and user_founder_number=None. Full /app/backend/tests/test_iter32_founder_mark.py suite now 6/6 PASS (was 5/6). (2) /founders Wall rows render <FounderMark testID='wall-founder-mark-{founder_id}' /> next to first_name (founders.tsx:139-144). Live page shows 2 founder rows and exactly 2 wall-founder-mark-* testIDs. Tapping the first opens a modal with title 'Founding Member #1', body 'One of the first 500 members who helped build the YouBelong community.', and a 'Got it' button (testID founder-mark-close) that dismisses it — all three strings match the spec verbatim. (3) BONUS — WebSocket broadcasts /api/ws/table/{id} (server.py:6215-6222) and /api/ws/dm/{id} (server.py:6261-6268) now stamp user_is_founder + user_founder_number onto the outgoing {type:'message', message:{...}} payload when the sender is a founder. New test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter33_ws_founder_broadcast.py confirms both rooms (table + DM) emit the founder flags on the broadcast frame — 2/2 PASS. Total tests run this iteration: 8 (6 REST + 2 WS), all pass. Wall butterflies cohort cap also displays correctly: '2 of 500 early members shaping YouBelong together.' No regressions observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Two harmless web-console warnings continue to fire on /founders: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and the same for textShadow*. Not blocking, but worth a sweep — likely coming from a shared card style in src/components or src/lib/theme.ts. React Native Web 0.20+ wants boxShadow/textShadow.

founders.tsx hero banner copy ('2 of 500 early members shaping YouBelong together. / JOIN FREE AS A FOUNDING MEMBER') is functionally fine but is the only screen in the app that uses ALL-CAPS for a CTA; design consistency with the Welcome screen which uses sentence case 'Join free as a Founding Member.' could be considered — purely cosmetic.
